messages:
eric-cs: Customer reported that their rerank call returns either identical scores or a 400/500 error after they send embeddings from a separate embed call. They say this started after they upgraded an internal model. Attaching short repro below.

alice-support: Can you paste the exact payload they use (sanitized) and the model names for both embed + rerank?

eric-cs: Payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  \"model\": \"rerank-v1\",          # customer's rerank model
  \"query_embedding\": [ ... ],         # returned from their embed call (model: embed-old)
  \"candidate_embeddings\": [ [ ... ], [ ... ], ... ]
}
```
They said embed model is `embed-old` (dims unknown) and they switched some clients to `embed-new` recently. Customer logs show: 
`warning: all scores 0.0` then later `500 RERANK_INTERNAL` when sending embed vectors from embed-new.

alice-support: Thanks. Assigning to eng. @suri-eng can you take a look?

suri-eng: I saw similar before — usually a dim mismatch or normalization change. Two quick checks: confirm vector length (len) and whether vectors are L2-normalized. Any chance embed-new changed output dim from 1536 -> 2048 or started returning uint8/quantized values?

eric-cs: Customer confirms embed-old produced 1536 floats, embed-new produces 2048 floats. They were unaware rerank requires matching dims. They passed both into the same rerank endpoint.

maria-ml: If rerank expects X-dim vectors and receives Y-dim, behavior depends on validation path. Ideally we should return 400 with a clear error, but older code sometimes falls back to compute and yields 0 scores or NaNs. Need repro and an internal test to validate strict checking.

alice-support: Customer wants root cause + short-term workaround. What can we tell them now?

suri-eng: Workarounds: 1) Re-encode all embeddings with the same embedding model (recommended). 2) If they must mix, run an offline conversion to the same dimensionality (PCA/projection) but that changes semantics. 3) On our side, we can implement explicit dim validation early and return 400 with message like `RERANK_INCOMPATIBLE_EMBED_DIM expected=1536 got=2048`. For now tell them to use the same embed model for query + candidates.

eric-cs: Customer asks whether normalization differences could cause identical scores rather than an error.

maria-ml: Yes — if candidates and queries get normalized differently (or one set is all zeros because quantization clipped), dot-product or cosine calculations can collapse. Example: if vectors become all zeros due to overflow/quantization mismatch you'll get zero scores. Also mixing float16 vs float32 in certain code paths produced NaNs in the past.

suri-eng: Repro steps for eng:
1) Grab a sample query + candidates encoded with embed-old (1536).
2) Generate same inputs with embed-new (2048).
3) Call /v1/rerank with mismatched dims; observe log: `ERROR validate_embeddings: expected 1536, got 2048` OR silent collapse to zeros depending on node version.

# quick local check snippet (send to customer):
```
import numpy as np
q = np.array(query_embedding)
print('query.shape=', q.shape)
c = np.array(candidate_embeddings[0])
print('candidate.shape=', c.shape)
```

sam-platform: I'll open a patch to add explicit dimension validation in the rerank handler and return 400 with a developer-friendly message. Filing RB: PLAT-8731. I'll also add a debug metric when we see mixed dims so support can triage faster.

eric-cs: Customer reply: they want a hotfix — they can roll back embed model to embed-old in the meantime. Can we verify there will be no silent fallback?

suri-eng: Short-term: tell them to rollback or re-embed. Long-term: our patch will fail fast with clear error. We'll try to get a canary out today.

deploy-bot: deploy request submitted by sam-platform for patch/PLAT-8731 -> canary, env=prod-canary, change=validate-rerank-dims

alice-support: I'll send the customer the repro checklist and a suggested rollback path. Keeping this thread open until the canary is green.

eric-cs: Customer ack'd rollback plan. Thanks team.

suri-eng: Follow-ups: add unit test for embedding dtype/shape validation, add doc blurb in rerank API docs that embed dims must match (include example of error response). Assigning to maria-ml for model onboarding checks to prevent future silent dim shifts.

maria-ml: I'll add a model-onboarding gate to warn when a model changes output dim. Also will add an evaluation that flags breaking changes.

eric-cs: Marking support ticket #SUP-54221 as awaiting canary result.

alice-support: noted, will update customer when canary is green or if we need more info.
